synthesis.profile_protocol: Folded into the FR13_SPEED_TAX_BASELINE.md deployment-regime campaign (B=4, BI=0, METRICS=0, SWE workload, /metrics-delta basis stays speed-of-record). Stage 0 (every boot, free): save docker_full.log + cuda_graph_proof per arm (engine-init cudagraph_mode, splitting_ops, Capturing-lines count, PIECEWISE/FULL memory line, assert no fallback warning; expect FULL largest=40 tree vs 24 native) — defines the evidence format the spec already requires. Stage 1 (LABELED diagnostic, counts/shares bind, absolute ms do not): ONE eager torch.profiler window per arm class (native-eager, legacy-cat9, replay-cat9, legacy-chain5, optional chain5+FORCE_PAD16) via existing VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1 /start_profile + new flag-gated VLLM_TORCH_PROFILER_DIR passthrough; BI=0, all diag envs OFF; warm 2 reqs then 1 pinned prompt x 64 tokens; extract per step: cudaLaunchKernel counts (suspect a), sync/DtoH/aten::item counts+times with stacks (suspect b, must reproduce 96/step + 6/step static counts), CPU-share between kernels (suspect c), top-30 kernels incl. tree-GDN per-launch at pad8 vs pad16 (suspect d + T6). Stage 2 (captured-mode dispatch evidence): cuda_graph_proof on speed-of-record arms (tree failing FULL IS the suspect-a verdict); ONE separate labeled diagnostic boot per tree arm with --observability-config '{"cudagraph_metrics":true,"enable_logging_iteration_details":true}' via new flag-gated FR13_VLLM_EXTRA_ARGS launcher hook -> per-step FULL/PIECEWISE/eager dispatch mix (the one number no existing log contains); nsys optional (availability in cu130-nightly unverified — check which nsys at next boot). Stage 3 (pad arms in the sweep): P2 definitive = chain5 vs chain5+FR13_FORCE_N_PAD=16 (minimal diagnostic env at patcher:227: validate pow2/>=derived/<=16, log served n_pad, launcher -e passthrough, default 0 = current behavior; semantically safe since n_actual<n_pad is the deployed cat9 config; pre-flight FA2 bias-mask pad audit); P1 cross-check = caterpillar7 vs caterpillar8 (no code change, dN=1, both depth-5, has_sibling=True) minus the within-pad16 slope from N in {9,12,13,15}; bind only if P1 and P2 agree; dummy-node idea rejected. Stage 4 (BI): deployment already mandates BI=0; optional one paired native BI=0/BI=1 diagnostic boot to pin S1. Invalidation rules: any tap/METRICS flag ON invalidates a speed number; replay arms inherit the accept-bug confound until the gate-4 fix.
